title: Opus 4.8 launch boosts Claude Code #opus48 #claudecode #anthropic
description:
Opus 4.8 just launched with major benchmark gains, stronger honesty, and lower misalignment rates than Opus 4.7. The release positions it as a top-tier model against GPT 5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, with the main exception being agentic terminal coding.

The biggest improvement is reliability: Opus 4.8 is presented as far more truthful, more willing to push back on bad prompts, and less likely to require constant correction. That makes it more useful for real-world workflows where trust, accuracy, and reduced oversight matter.

Anthropic also introduced new capabilities including dynamic workflows, allowing Claude Code to break large jobs into hundreds of sub-agents within a single session. That points to a broader shift toward AI systems that can manage complex, multi-step execution rather than just answer prompts.

The release also teased Claude Mythos, suggesting a near-term expansion of Anthropic’s most advanced model lineup and raising the stakes in the competition around trustworthy, agentic AI.
